entities.summary: Energy and Technology Museum is a science industrial destination in Vilnius, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A transformed power station with interactive energy and technology experiences that materially exceed passive industrial heritage. This entry is intended for 7–teen travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
